name: Japan Entertainer BioData
description: Backward-compatible profile optimized for Philippines-to-Japan entertainer biodata documents.

extraction.system_prompt: You accurately extract structured information from biodata documents. Return only valid JSON without explanations.

fields.label: Surname
fields.description: Surname/family name from the surname field.

fields.label: Given Names
fields.description: All names written in the given name(s) or first name field.

fields.label: Middle Name
fields.description: Middle name exactly as written; empty string if absent.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Category/occupation as written in the document.

instructions: Extract every employment record from sections such as Employment Records.
For employment in Japan, set country exactly to "Japan". Use the address, country name, Japanese prefecture names, or Japanese city names as evidence.
For every non-Japan employment record, set country exactly to "Philippines" for this profile.
Extract only the employment period dates into start_date and end_date; do not include employer names in date fields.
Preserve the source English date wording such as MAY 8, 2016 or July 3, 2024.
Return records from oldest to newest when the order can be determined.

general_instructions: Correct obvious OCR confusions such as 0/O, 1/I, and 8/B when context makes the intended value clear.
Do not invent values that are not supported by the document.
Keep source date wording; Excel formatting is handled later by the program.
